relationships.subject: Dendrobii Officinalis Caulis water extract
relationships.evidence_quote: down-regulated the mRNA levels of TLR4, MyD88, NF-κB, ICAM-1, and VCAM-1 as well as the protein levels of TLR4, NF-κB, and IL-6 in the aortic tissue

relationships.subject: Dendrobii Officinalis Caulis water extract
relationships.evidence_quote: the water extract decreased the content of IL-1β, TNF-α, IL-6, and CRP in the serum

relationships.subject: Dendrobii Officinalis Caulis water extract
relationships.evidence_quote: the Dendrobii Officinalis Caulis water extract may regulate the endothelial inflammatory injury via the TLR4/NF-κB/ICAM-1 pathway

key_findings: Dendrobii Officinalis Caulis water extract improved blood rheology and endothelial injury in hyperviscosity rats
It lowered serum TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, IL-6 and CRP and downregulated aortic TLR4/MyD88/NF-κB
